2993769.title: Andong Su (Water) Festa
2993769.overview: A summer water festival on the Nakdong riverbanks: giant water slides, pools, and paddleboard zones by day, then 'Andong Summer Night' concerts and fireworks after dark — with auto and tent camping so you can stay the night at the festival itself.

589170.title: Geoje Summer Marine Festival
589170.overview: A participatory ocean festival at Jisepo Port: a large water world with toddler pools, ocean-gun battles, a paper-boat 'shipyard' contest, yacht, kayak, and paddleboard sessions, plus a food festa, kids' playground, and an ocean horror parade — Geoje's shipbuilding-island summer at full tilt.

4088149.title: Balcony Music Show & Street Festa
4088149.overview: Gwangbok-ro's car-free street becomes a stage from July to December: fusion gugak, jazz, K-pop dance, tap, and popera on street spots — and the signature Balcony Music Show, performed from actual building balconies above the crowd, with sing-along parades and 60 Busan local brands.

2019366.title: KIMA WEEK Marine Leisure Festival
2019366.overview: Korea's flagship marine-leisure festival, running since 2013 at Dadaepo Beach: try-anything water sports sessions open to all, the KIMA Beach culture zone, family programs, and performances — the sea made approachable on Busan's sunset shore.
2019366.sponsor: Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries · Busan

2394558.title: Gyeongpo Summer Festival
2394558.overview: Seven days of beach life on Gyeongpo: giant claw-machine games and sand challenges by day, pine-grove picnic game zones, beer gardens on weekends, water-gun battles, and a different artist genre plus EDM party every single night.

2992167.title: Yeongju Cool Night Festa
2992167.overview: Yeongju's signature summer night market festival at the civic stadium: multi-genre stages, local food, atmospheric open-air drinking yards, and all-generation programs — a stay-late festival built to cool the old downtown's summer nights.

1340294.title: Geomundo-Baekdo Silver Sea Festival
1340294.overview: On remote Geomundo island off Yeosu — gateway to the jagged Baekdo islets: cruise tours, traditional dragnet fishing, bare-hand fish catching, performances of the island's designated boat songs, a 'silver song contest', and fresh island seafood with sea-breeze mugwort to taste.

2611034.title: Sokcho Summer Festival
2611034.overview: Three days on Sokcho Beach: a retro arcade tournament ('Reply Arcade'), the Summer Splash water-run survival battle, dance crews and crowd grooving, then Beach Sound concerts and the Summer Night Electric DJ festival after dark — with free DIY crafts and a 14-team local food market.

2497537.title: Hangang Night Walk 42K
2497537.overview: Walk the Han River all night: Korea's signature night-walking festival offers 42K, 22K, and 14K courses from Yeouido, prizing completion over competition — eleven years of walkers watching Seoul's river lights from dusk to sunrise.

3498395.title: Night Race in Busan
3498395.overview: A night running festival over Gwangalli Beach and the Gwangan Bridge: the signature stretch runs the bridge's normally closed upper deck above the lit-up sea — music, photo zones, and festival energy over finishing times.

3514951.title: Illustar Fes 12
3514951.overview: A subculture fair at BEXCO with some 1,000 individual and team creators selling illustration books, goods, and albums of original and fan works, plus game companies from mobile to Nintendo and Steam, an indie-game hall, and the cosplay crowds and stage shows that fill the venue.

1825508.title: Samgilpo Rockfish Festival
1825508.overview: The 20th rockfish festival at the pretty harbor of Samgilpo: traditional stone-weir fishing, platform angling, fry releases at sea, bare-hand conger catching in air pools — and free fresh rockfish sashimi from the festival committee, with spicy maeuntang all around.

2539802.title: Hongcheon River Starlight Music & Beer Festival
2539802.overview: 'Cool Music, Cold Beer!' — the 10th edition of Hongcheon's summer flagship: Terra draft straight from Korea's largest brewery (the HiteJinro Gangwon plant is local), Hongcheon craft brewers, a World Wet Dance contest, and EDM, rap, and hip-hop stages in the Tori Forest park.

2557842.title: Jeonju Gamaek Festival
2557842.overview: 'Drink today the beer made today': Jeonju's gamaek culture — cold beer with dried squid and snacks at corner shops — scaled into a festival, with same-day beer from the local HiteJinro plant, dishes from the city's certified gamaek joints, and summer-night stages. Entry 1,000 won.

2644679.title: Busan International Buddhism Expo
2644679.overview: Buddhism gone hip at BEXCO: 370 booths of temple food, meditation art and experience zones, traditional practice, and Buddhist crafts — this year playfully themed on the Heart Sutra's emptiness ('form is emptiness: the ball games you love'). Half price with advance booking.

4091116.title: LH Housing Gallery Culture Hideout
4091116.overview: LH's model-home galleries in Sejong, Incheon, Paju, and Namyangju turn their idle space into open cultural lounges: weekly one-day classes, local artists' stages, and cool indoor rest — an urban culture vacation without leaving town.
4091116.place: LH galleries in Sejong, Incheon, Paju, Namyangju

4070865.title: Miryang Su-per Festival
4070865.overview: Water play, sport, and stages on the Miryang River: a big pool complex and water slides, water bikes and pedal boats on the river, 'super challenge' races anyone can join, and DJ and concert nights with food trucks along the banks.

2989846.title: Songdo Beach Festival
2989846.overview: An artificial white-sand beach and themed pools under Songdo's glass skyline: retro rides recalling the old Songdo amusement park, cultural stages, and food stalls — family water play by day, the district's famous night views by evening.

3517184.title: Hangang Bridge Cinema
3517184.overview: Open-air movies under the Han River bridges: Saturday nights at 20:00 for three weeks, free screenings beneath Wonhyo, Cheongdam, and Cheonho bridges — Seoul's coolest (literally) summer cinema, with citizen photo-contest winners on screen from 19:00.
3517184.place: Under Wonhyo Bridge, Yeouido Hangang Park (and 2 more)

1684261.title: Dunnae Highland Tomato Festival
1684261.overview: Dive into a pool of tomatoes: the headline 'find the golden ring' hunt hides real gold rings and prizes in a tomato pool, alongside tomato stacking and weighing games, water slides, KBS's National Singing Contest, and highland-tomato tastings in cool Hoengseong.

1916616.title: Suwon Heritage Night
1916616.overview: Suwon Hwaseong — the UNESCO-listed fortress — after dark: eight night themes (views, roads, history, art, markets, food and more) light up Banghwasuryujeong pavilion, Hwahongmun gate, the Yongyeon pond, and Haenggung plaza with exhibitions, performances, and hands-on programs.

3383748.title: Dadaepo Sunset Film Festival
3383748.overview: Cinema against Busan's most famous sunset: a beach red carpet, opening and closing screenings on the sand, a national short-film competition, audience talks, concerts, and the 'Dadaepocha' food market — film and nature sharing one horizon.

3542294.title: Guardians of Jinju Mission Tour
3542294.overview: A web-based mystery mission game through Jinjuseong Fortress at night: three story series — a historical narrative, a three-character whodunit, and a fantasy edition in Korean and English — played by collecting clues among the lantern-lit fortress grounds, no app needed, souvenirs on completion.

1539730.title: Annotated Youth Concert: Summer Story
1539730.overview: The original commentary concert for young audiences, 23 years running and reliably sold out: a piano quartet plays the classical hits you know from films and ads, sorted by mood and moment, with the signature live commentary at Sejong Chamber Hall.

4093783.title: Hongseong Heritage Night
4093783.overview: 'The walled town with a secret': Hongju-eupseong — seat of Joseon's Hongju magistracy and battleground of the righteous armies — opens at night with special lighting, history performances, heritage experiences, media content, and local food inside the old walls.

2736033.title: BIC Festival (Busan Indie Connect)
2736033.overview: Korea's largest indie-game-only festival since 2015: 250+ indie games from around the world playable at BEXCO under the slogan 'Buff your Indie Spirit', with stage events, streaming content, and a three-week online festival alongside.

4097098.title: Gamtan Road Travel Gacha Pop-up
4097098.overview: A travel gacha arcade in Seongsu: pull capsule prizes to discover Taebaek, Samcheok, Yeongwol, and Jeongseon — Gangwon's former coal country reborn as travel destinations — with a photo gallery, quizzes on the mining-to-tourism story, and a black wall visitors fill with colorful messages.

4087207.title: Gyeongju Esports Festival
4087207.overview: Korea's biggest amateur gaming event meets a water park: the 18th President's Cup amateur esports finals, the national para-esports championship, and the Gyeongju Water Pool Festival with giant pools and water bounces — competitive gaming and summer splash in the ancient capital.

4098916.title: Yeogijeogi Festival in Cheorwon
4098916.overview: Tourism startups test-drive their newest ideas on real travelers in DMZ-adjacent Cheorwon: AI and data-driven travel services, experiential content built on the county's nature and history, and a local flea market — a proof-of-concept festival where your feedback shapes the products.
4098916.sponsor: Ministry of SMEs and Startups · Gangwon · Cheorwon

1068150.title: Samcheonpo Gizzard Shad Festival
1068150.overview: Autumn's famous fish, straight off the boats: Sacheon's 23rd jeoneo (gizzard shad) festival at the Palpo food district serves the oily, nutty seasonal catch — grilled whole or as sashimi — at the peak of its late-summer run, a nationally known food festival in a clean-water port.

4097059.title: Pohang Chimaek Festival
4097059.overview: Chicken and beer by the sea pavilion: two days at Yeongildae with chimaek sales zones, invited and citizen stages, EDM parties, a song contest, 'Chimaek Star K' and chimaek-king contests, water and art zones, and receipt lucky draws against the night sea.

1840830.title: Busan International Comedy Festival
1840830.overview: Asia's first international comedy festival, launched 2013: top comedians from home and abroad play stages across the whole city, crossing generations and borders — K-comedy's flagship showcase, discovering new content and talent each summer.

2843892.title: Wonju Rooftop Film Festival
2843892.overview: Ten years of independent cinema on Wonju rooftops: a free, non-competitive summer-night festival planned by local youth, opening with a Gangwon short-film selection — programmed, staffed, and run by citizen-activists as true community cinema, this year atop the Korea Tourism Organization building.

1073801.title: Yeongyang Chili H.O.T Festival
1073801.overview: Korea's most famous chili county sets up on Seoul Plaza: the largest single-item direct farm market in the country, selling Yeongyang's prized gochu straight from growers, with culture programs, tastings, and exhibitions bridging farm and city.

2853756.title: Saengsaeng Korean Music Festival
2853756.overview: Live and unplugged Korean traditional music in the small venues of Bongdam: artists selected from 120 national applicants play three days across ten neighborhood spots — little libraries, cafes, book shops, and a lake park — an award-winning grassroots gugak festival.

3340192.title: Creator Media Festival
3340192.overview: Korea's biggest creator-industry event at COEX Magok: a main stage streamed live on YouTube, fan meetings, live-commerce demos, AI and new-tech zones, platform talk shows, business matching, busking, DIY goods, and flea markets — 'the square where everyone's creation gathers'.

3346571.title: Ganggyeong Heritage Night
3346571.overview: The old river-port town of Ganggyeong — once one of Joseon's three great markets — links its scattered modern-era heritage into one walkable night: landscape lighting and media art down the historic street, 30 programs across 8 night themes reinterpreting the town's trading-era stories.

3339982.title: Gochang Nongak Kkotdaerim Festival
3339982.overview: Gochang's designated farmers'-music tradition celebrates its harvest-blessing kkotdaerim rite: pungmul, gate, and pan gut performances at the nongak training center, with invited music and theater acts, participation programs, markets, and scholarly exchange — three days where players, scholars, and villagers share one yard.

4103719.title: Jeonpo Saitgil Beer Festival
4103719.overview: Beer Road returns to the alleys of Jeonpo: DJ sets and bachata parties on the main stage, a standing beer-and-food lounge of drum-can tables and beer machines, and a mellow craft-beer lounge with floor seating and its own DJ — Busan's coolest cafe district after dark.

1953493.title: Muan Red-Clay Mudflat Festival
1953493.overview: 'The mudflat is alive': an eco-festival on the UNESCO-listed Muan getbol — Korea's first protected wetland — at the Hwangto Mudflat Land, with its 1.5km over-sea boardwalk, tidal-flat ecology programs, exhibitions, and family activities on the living red-clay flats.

2989981.title: Seocho Music & Art Festival (SMAF)
2989981.overview: The express-bus-terminal district becomes a culture plaza: Seocho's young summer festival stages a music-meets-fashion K-culture show in the Goter-Sebit tourism zone, with linked programs across the district — downtown Seoul's newest late-summer evening out.

4099133.title: Local Ground Yeonnam
4099133.overview: Yeonnam-dong's alleys as one festival: flea markets, busking, and events connecting the neighborhood's independent shops with the picnic culture of the Gyeongui Line Forest Park — wander, linger, and discover the backstreets behind Seoul's favorite stroll.

2991394.title: Busan Night Walk 42K
2991394.overview: An overnight walking festival from APEC Naru Park: courses of 42K, 24K, 16K, and a new family 8K trace the Suyeong riverside and Oncheoncheon stream to Gwangalli Beach — crossing the newly opened Suyeong Human Bridge with Busan's night skyline for company.

4090802.title: Ansan Esports Festival
4090802.overview: A city gaming day at the Kim Yeon-koung Gymnasium: League of Legends and Tales Runner tournament finals, cosplay performance contests, retro and Brawl Stars play zones, and meet-and-greets with gaming influencers and cosplayers — free for all ages.

3315407.title: Jemulpo Wave Market
3315407.overview: Incheon's local brands in one harborside hall: this edition's theme is gastronomy, with 50 of the city's cafes and restaurants joining handmade candles, perfume, and craft stalls — plus blind tastings, lucky draws, craft workshops, and busking at the Sangsang Platform.

2843904.title: Jinju Heritage Night
2843904.overview: Jinjuseong Fortress and the old downtown by night, themed on the amhaengeosa (secret royal inspectors): eight night themes of views, performances, exhibitions, guided history walks, and night markets connecting the fortress's heritage with the city's living streets.

3486887.title: Waegwan Holy Festival
3486887.overview: Holiday in a holy place: Waegwan Abbey — Korea's Benedictine monastery with a medieval-European air — opens for light installations ('cathedral of light', 'dream forest'), Gregorian chant and pipe-organ concerts, talk shows with a young priest, monastery tours with monks, and monk's-habit photo booths.

3372317.title: Hwajeokyeon: A Thousand-Year Promise
3372317.overview: An open-air musical staged on the real scenery of Hwajeokyeon — the scenic-monument rock pool where Joseon rain rites were held: dramatic lighting on the natural stage, musical star Hong Ji-min with a cast of Pocheon citizens, two performances, all seats free.

4104765.title: Gangwon Livestock Fair
4104765.overview: Korea's oldest livestock competition, running since 1968: Gangwon's farms present their finest hanwoo cattle for rigorous judging at the Gangneung Dano grounds, with premium-beef contests proving the province's breeding achievements — a farmers' gathering with real stakes.

3348418.title: Upcycling Festival
3348418.overview: A circular-economy festival at the Seoul Upcycling Plaza: upcycled-goods markets, repair programs, hands-on upcycling workshops, exhibitions, performances, and picnic space — companies, creators, and citizens practicing resource circulation together, run as a low-waste event itself.

3305165.title: Jikji Culture Festival
3305165.overview: Celebrating Jikji — the world's oldest extant book printed with movable metal type, a UNESCO Memory of the World — on the anniversary of its listing: 'Jikji opens the door of time' brings exhibitions, printing experiences, performances, and lectures to Cheongju's Early Printing Museum quarter.
3305165.place: Cheongju Early Printing Museum and Arts Center

4106106.title: Wonju Heritage Night
4106106.overview: 'Observing Wonju's history' at the Gangwon Gamyeong — the old provincial governor's compound — with the cathedral and colonial bank building alongside: eight night themes woven around three historical figures, from the righteous-army commander Min Geung-ho to the poet-governor Jeong Cheol.

3343694.title: Rural Madang Theater Festival
3343694.overview: Open-yard madang theater brought to the countryside: begun as an arts festival for underserved rural audiences and now drawing city visitors too, its 22nd edition fills the restored Chojeong Haenggung palace with traditional performance, play, and shared laughter — free in the famous mineral-spring village.

4097339.title: Youth Culture Week
4097339.overview: 'Today's youth, today's culture': the culture ministry's youth festival takes over a Hongdae cafe with performances, talks, workshops, and community programs spanning arts, travel, sport, and lifestyle — young creators, planners, and brands showing what Korean youth culture is right now.
4097339.sponsor: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism

2614763.title: Gongju Heritage Night
2614763.overview: Ten straight years of night heritage in the old royal capital: this year marks the centenary of the 1926 Gongju city map with the subtitle '1926 Gongju Romantic Banquet' — eight night themes around the old town hall, first church, and other modern-era heritage of the walking royal district.

2843521.title: Yesan Stork Festival
2843521.overview: An eco-festival in the village that brought storks back: Korea's reintroduced storks return here on strong homing instinct, and the 7th festival shares the village's habitat-restoration work through exhibitions and hands-on ecology programs at the Yesan Stork Park.

3115326.title: Mungyeong Trot Song Contest
3115326.overview: Korea's beloved trot genre in full competition mode: finalists chosen from nationwide auditions battle it out at Mungyeong's riverside sports park, with star performances by Park Seo-jin and Kim Hee-jae, prize events, and fireworks to close the night.

3301281.title: Dalseong Family Festival YES! Kids Zone
3301281.overview: Dalseong's flagship children's festival at the National Daegu Science Museum: big balloon and bubble shows, comedy circus, magic and science-magic stages, hands-on booths from every district, and special appearances by kids' creators — a full family day, mostly free.

2560161.title: Hello Maker
2560161.overview: The National Busan Science Museum's 10th-anniversary maker festival: build ideas into real things at creation workshops for all ages, browse maker exhibits, and join the network of Korea's tinkerers — free entry, workshops from 3,000 won.

2434313.title: Seongbuk Book Festival (Chaekmokkoji)
2434313.overview: Seongbuk's library-network reading festival spreads along the Seongbukcheon stream: 18 teams — 13 district libraries plus universities and reading groups — run themed booths, an open-air library under the autumn sun, afternoon busking, and evening choir and folk-ensemble stages by the water.
2434313.place: Seongbukcheon stream by the district office
